column3: “At once” renders the command to rise; “reveal My message” replaces causing you to hear My words.
“Treats his clay” makes the comparison explicit.
“Rocky slopes” renders the rock of the field; “run dry” renders the waters being uprooted.
“Idols” specifies vanity; “rutted” is added to the bypaths.
The object is reversed in the sword clause: the Hebrew pours them into the sword’s hands, whereas the translation pours the sword’s power upon them. “Disease” specifies death.
